eligibility_logic: Unit's sector falls in thrust sector #6

incentive: MSME Industrial Promotion Subsidy (SGST-linked) by taluka basket
eligibility_logic: MSME AND eligible taluka basket AND scheme-conditions (per PSI)
values_as_stated: A 30%/5y; B 40%/7y; C 50%/7y; D 60%/10y; D+ 70%/10y; Vidarbha/Marathwada/Ratnagiri/Sindhudurg/Jalgaon/Dhule 80%/10y; no-industry/Naxal/aspirational 100%/10y (of eligible base as defined in scheme)

eligibility_logic: MSME AND (export >=50% OR >=50% recycled-material circular unit OR women/SC/ST/PwD-owned with >=50% women staff)
values_as_stated: Up to Rs 25 cr or 20% of FCI; Rs 5 cr/yr (as stated in GR)

eligibility_logic: C/D/D+ baskets; A/B only EOU (>=50% export) or women/SC/ST/PwD
Investment & employment thresholds by basket (e.g., A/B Rs 750 cr / 1000 jobs for special LSI)
